words.prose: {{ar:إِرَمَ}} ({{tr:irama}}) does not restart the sentence after 89:6; it specifies the prior {{ar:عَادٍ}} ({{tr:ʿĀdin}}) reference inside the same governed object chain. That makes the ayah break part of the identification: the listener has to carry the previous prepositional frame forward before the name can settle. The word is definite as a proper name, but it is also opaque and rare, so recognition arrives through the next two words, {{ar:ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ}} ({{tr:dhāti al-ʿimādi}}), rather than through an ordinary lexical label. It also becomes the first named display answer to the prior question about how the Lord acted, shifting inquiry into nominal presentation. Debated etymologies, marker-stone associations, and sound variants such as Arima or Aramma can make the name feel physically marked, prestigious, and already shadowed by ruin, but the local grammar keeps those pressures secondary: the surface is first a name, then a name made visible by its support-bearing epithet.

words.prose: {{ar:ذَاتِ}} ({{tr:dhāti}}) is the hinge that prevents {{ar:إِرَمَ}} ({{tr:irama}}) from remaining a bare label. As a feminine construct head, it must be completed by {{ar:ٱلْعِمَادِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿimādi}}), so the supports are not a loose image after the name; they become the attribute through which Iram is identified. The recited join from {{ar:ذَاتِ}} ({{tr:dhāti}}) to {{ar:ٱلْعِمَادِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿimādi}}) reinforces that bond, and the longer cadence after short {{ar:إِرَمَ}} ({{tr:irama}}) slows the moment where the bare name becomes relational description. The word also does more than a simple adjective would do: it lets possession, bearing, and defining quality overlap, so Iram can be remembered by structures it has and by the structural character those supports give it. The feminine form leaves the referent open enough for place, city, tribe-name, or collective identity, while the local construct frame keeps relative-pronoun and demonstrative branches out of play. Variant shapes with tanwīn or accusative pressure show how much the base reading depends on tight construct closure, and the same possessor pattern resonates inside the surah by naming reason (89:5), pillars here, and Pharaoh's stakes (89:10), while also joining attribute-bearing formulas elsewhere (85:1; 51:7; 86:11).

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعِمَادِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿimādi}}) is the word that makes the three-word scene visible. As the definite genitive complement of {{ar:ذَاتِ}} ({{tr:dhāti}}), it closes the construct and sends specificity backward through the epithet: Iram is known by the supports. The noun remains concrete but not archaeologically narrow; its singular or collective form can gather pillars, columns, tent-poles, posts, or load-bearing frames into one civilizational signature. The wider {{ar:ع م د}} ({{tr:ʿ-m-d}}) field includes intentional aiming, propping, and reliance, so the selected support image can feel engineered and dependency-bearing without turning the local noun into a verb of intending. Because the ayah has no event verb, this final word has unusual weight: after name and relation, it supplies the visual answer to the earlier question about divine action, and the support image prepares the next ayah's unmatched-likeness claim (89:8). Even its sound does some work: the firm guttural-to-dental texture and long final i cadence let the support image settle at the close rather than pass quickly. Its Quranic support field is also unstable in a revealing way: heavens stand without visible pillars (13:2; 31:10), while pillars become enclosing punishment in 104:9, so Iram's prestige marker is already vulnerable inside the broader vocabulary of supports.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun عِمَادِ at word 3 is made a defining possession of Iram by the construction إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: Propping, concrete columns, and elevated structure converge on a built environment whose identity lies in conspicuous load-bearing verticality.

activation_trace.role: The image of propping something upright supplies the load-bearing function of Iram's defining structures.
The literal pillar or column image supplies the visible architectural members of the model.
The image of height and elevated structure turns the supports into a skyline and a claim to prominence.

changed_reading.before: Iram bears an unspecified epithet involving supports.
changed_reading.after: Iram is characterized as a monumental vertical system: a place or formation made recognizable by what holds it high.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: عِمَادِ at word 3 can identify people through the poles around which their dwellings are erected.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same concrete pole can classify a mode of habitation rather than a masonry city, so ذات العماد may mark a mobile people whose collective space repeatedly rises around tent supports.

activation_trace.role: The image of tent dwellers literally links people to poles and makes a mobile social formation the phrase's referent.
The concrete pole image supplies the repeatable center from which each dwelling is raised.

changed_reading.before: The phrase describes a fixed city furnished with columns.
changed_reading.after: The phrase can instead describe a people of poles, with mobility and tent-based dwelling constitutive of Iram's identity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessive epithet ذات العماد remains attached to عِمَادِ at word 3 while the root inventory permits human and systemic supports.
baseline_models.mechanism: A mainstay relied upon by a group and the central part that gives an affair its standing shift the phrase from construction materials to the persons or institutions that keep a polity coherent.

activation_trace.role: The reliable chief or mainstay image supplies a human support on whom the group depends.
The central supporting part supplies the institutional core that gives the whole formation its standing.

changed_reading.before: The supports are only architectural objects.
changed_reading.after: Iram may be 'possessor of mainstays': a polity defined by concentrated human or institutional supports.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root of عِمَادِ at word 3 also carries deliberate aiming alongside the act of supporting.
baseline_models.mechanism: The actional branch colors the physical supports as products of sustained intention: Iram's standing is designed, aimed at, and maintained rather than accidental.

activation_trace.role: The image of intentional aiming supplies deliberate purpose behind the structures or system.
The propping image gives that intention a concrete result: something deliberately made to stand.

changed_reading.before: Iram merely happens to have supports.
changed_reading.after: Iram's supports register organized intention, a deliberately erected and maintained order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered movement from dawn through counted nights, pair and single, and a traveling night activates العماد as an axis around which alternation, counting, and passage become intelligible.

activation_trace.role: The central supporting part supplies an axial center rather than only a building member.
Dawn breaking from night supplies the first temporal transition organized around the proposed axis.
Night and its darkness supply the recurring interval through which the axis is tracked.
Completion of nine by a tenth supplies bounded sequence and turns recurrence into an ordered span.
Joining a thing to its like supplies the paired pole of the sequence.
The unpaired single supplies the contrasting pole and keeps the ordering from collapsing into sameness.
Night travel supplies motion through the ordered intervals, making the support a coordinate for passage.

structural_cues: The packet orders 89:1-4 as rupture, count, alternation, and movement before naming Iram.
Night recurs in 89:2 and 89:4, but the second occurrence is mobile rather than static.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal alternation, enumeration, and nocturnal motion; I supply the arrow from those patterns to العماد as an orienting axis. A live alternative is that the oath sequence frames the narrative rhetorically without redescribing Iram's supports.

changed_reading.before: The pillars are static objects occupying space.
changed_reading.after: The supports can also behave as an axis of orientation, making Iram a fixed coordinate against the passing and counting of time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Oath, restraining discernment, directed seeing, enacted work, sovereignty, and the naming of عاد move Iram's deliberately erected order into an evidentiary frame: its supports are something the addressee is made to inspect as an accomplished but answerable design.

activation_trace.role: Intentional aiming supplies purpose within Iram's defining support system.
The apportioned oath supplies a solemn frame in which the ensuing object is presented as evidence.
Reason as a restraining barrier supplies the discerning audience expected to infer from the exhibit.
The attention-directing interrogative use supplies the act of making the addressee inspect what follows.
The production of an act supplies the event against which Iram's erected order becomes answerable.
Lordship and sovereignty supply an authority above the polity's own mainstays.
The branch containing عاد as a name fixes the named group to which Iram is appositionally attached.

structural_cues: The branchless ك ي ف at 89:6 is used only as an interrogative structural cue and receives no invented citation.
89:6 names عاد immediately before 89:7 names إرم, creating a tight appositional or identifying sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an oath, an appeal to discerning restraint, a seeing-question, divine action, and the عاد name; I infer that Iram's supports function as inspected evidence rather than neutral scenery. The live alternative is a simpler historical identification with no forensic coloring of العماد.

changed_reading.before: Iram's purposeful supports are a self-contained achievement.
changed_reading.after: They become an exhibit of purposeful power placed under a higher act and a discerning gaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured formation, denied similitude, and bounded lands intensify the focus branches of column and height: the supports are not incidental details but the differentiating form by which Iram exceeds comparable formations.

activation_trace.role: Concrete pillars supply the salient form whose comparability is denied.
Elevated structure supplies the exceptional scale or prominence attributed to that form.
Measuring and proportioning a thing supplies designed form rather than undifferentiated size.
The image of a counterpart supplies the comparison class that the clause negates.
A bounded tract of land supplies the spatial field across which no counterpart is found.

structural_cues: The feminine singular relative in 89:8 can continue the named إرم, while its exact referent remains open.
The negated passive creation and comparison clause immediately follows the pillar epithet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies formed creation, likeness, and lands; I infer that العماد is the differentiating design carried into that comparison. A live alternative is that 89:8 compares the people or Iram as a whole, with the pillars only one incidental trait.

changed_reading.before: Iram is one elevated or pole-bearing formation among others.
changed_reading.after: Its supports become the signature of an unmatched designed form, whether the compared entity is a city, a people, or their whole formation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Penetrating cuts through massive rock in a flood-channel and the fixed verticality of driven stakes recast the focus pillars as one element in a larger technology of anchoring, excavation, and inhabiting resistant terrain.

activation_trace.role: Propping something upright supplies engineered load transfer rather than ornament alone.
Concrete columns supply Iram's vertical intervention in the terrain.
A penetrating cut supplies the subtractive engineering paired with Iram's additive supports.
Massive hard rock supplies the resistant material against which that engineering is measured.
The valley as a stream-course supplies a channel-shaped landscape rather than an abstract location.
The driven stake supplies a second fixed vertical member and makes anchoring a repeated civilizational image.

structural_cues: 89:7-10 places pillars, rock-cutting, a valley, and stakes in a compact sequence across three named powers.
The material operations alternate between raising, cutting, channeling, and fixing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distinct examples with supports, rock cuts, a stream-course, and stakes; I infer an analogical technology of terrain control across them. The live alternative is that the examples remain separate and no engineering property transfers back to Iram.

changed_reading.before: The pillars are isolated architectural prestige objects.
changed_reading.after: They participate in an engineered landscape, one technique among coordinated acts of raising, cutting, channeling, and anchoring.

context_deltas.mechanism: Overflow beyond limit, multiplication, loss of right order, pouring, punitive mixture, and watchful interception turn support into a stress model: a civilization may stand materially while its governing load path has already failed.

activation_trace.role: The propping image supplies a system expected to carry and distribute load.
The central supporting part supplies the polity's load-bearing order rather than merely its facade.
Overtopping water and sweeping force supply the image of load exceeding a containing limit.
Numerical increase supplies accumulating pressure within the system.
Departure from soundness and balance supplies internal structural failure.
Pouring supplies the downward applied force that answers the prior overflow.
Mixing one thing into another supplies a compounded scourge rather than a single clean force.
Watchful interception supplies the checkpoint at which apparent stability is finally tested.

structural_cues: 89:11-14 moves causally from exceeded limits to multiplied disorder, poured response, and watchful interception.
The repeated locative field of the lands keeps this stress sequence attached to civilizational order.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overflow, increase, corruption, pouring, mixture, and surveillance; I map them onto a support-and-load mechanism whose moral direction is reader-supplied. A live alternative is that these are consecutive moral and punitive images without any structural metaphor for العماد.

changed_reading.before: Possessing supports guarantees strength and endurance.
changed_reading.after: The phrase can expose a mismatch between visible supports and failed moral load-bearing: Iram stands high while the order that should justify its standing has gone unsound.

context_deltas.mechanism: Testing reveals a social order in which the child has lost a guardian, the abased poor person is not supported, inherited goods are gathered wholesale, and wealth is amassed. Against that sequence, Iram's mainstays become an ethical question: whom did its strength actually hold up?

activation_trace.role: The person relied upon by a group supplies the expected human mainstay that the later conduct withholds.
The central supporting part supplies a criterion for judging whether the social whole is actually held together.
Testing that makes a condition visible supplies the diagnostic frame for the social failures.
A child cut off from a guardian supplies the clearest case of a missing human support.
Urging toward an act supplies the absent social pressure that should mobilize support.
Abasement through poverty supplies the vulnerable position that requires a mainstay.
Property passing from predecessor to heir supplies the social resource being appropriated.
Gathering dispersed things into one mass supplies the concentrating action that defeats distribution.
Acquiring and multiplying wealth supplies the object around which support is wrongly centralized.
Accumulation until fullness supplies the terminal image of concentrated rather than shared capacity.

structural_cues: 89:15-16 presents wealth and restriction as tests, then 89:17-20 corrects the human diagnosis by naming neglected dependents and concentrated goods.
The sequence moves from claimed honor to failed honoring, making support relational rather than decorative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a revealing test, missing guardianship, absent urging, poverty, inheritance, and accumulation; I infer that the mainstay branch of العماد sets an ethical standard for distributing support. A live alternative is that Iram and the later social indictment are separate examples joined only by the surah's broader admonition.

changed_reading.before: Iram's mainstays indicate concentrated civic strength.
changed_reading.after: The epithet also asks whether a civilization's strength reaches those without supports; monumental العماد becomes indictable when social mainstays are absent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus raises a singular vertical order; the later scene pounds the ground level, brings the sovereign presence, and arranges angels in repeated horizontal rows. One geometry of power is dismantled and replaced by another.

activation_trace.role: Literal columns supply the initial vertical geometry that the later leveling reverses.
Height and elevated structure supply the prominence removed by the flattening sequence.
Pounding and demolition until level supplies the direct reversal of erected height.
The lower plane opposed to the sky supplies the surface onto which vertical distinction is reduced.
Arrival and realized presence supply the event that replaces inherited monumental presence.
Sovereignty supplies the authority under which the geometry is reordered.
The branch image of an affair's ملاك as its own mainstay unexpectedly echoes العماد and transfers true support away from Iram.
Alignment on a level line supplies the repeated horizontal order that succeeds the fallen vertical one.

structural_cues: The thrice-rooted wording in 89:21 repeats the leveling action, and 89:22 repeats صفًّا.
Vertical height at the focus is answered by flattened earth and linearly ordered ranks.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies elevation, repeated leveling, arrival, sovereignty, a lexical mainstay echo, and repeated rows; I infer a deliberate geometric reversal from human verticality to divinely ordered horizontality. A live alternative is that the destruction and rows belong only to the final scene and do not retrospectively color Iram.

changed_reading.before: Iram's height is a stable visual fact and an index of durable power.
changed_reading.after: Its pillars become provisional verticality, anticipated as levelable and replaceable by an order whose members stand in equal rows.

context_deltas.mechanism: Late recollection and the wish to have sent something ahead redirect the intentional-aim branch of العماد: the issue is no longer whether a society can realize a vast design, but whether its intention builds toward the life for which advance provision matters.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate aiming supplies the purposive energy behind Iram's erected order.
Recovering what was absent from attention supplies the belated recognition that the earlier aim was misplaced.
A prior deed or advanced standing supplies the temporal direction that intention should have taken.
Aiming toward something supplies a direct purposive resonance with the focus root and makes the contrast one of targets.
Life as benefit and good supplies the destination against which monumental purpose is reevaluated.

structural_cues: 89:23 places recollection after the decisive arrival, and 89:24 voices a counterfactual wish about prior action.
The purposive resonance between the focus root and the branch of ق د م links two different targets of deliberate action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deliberate aim, belated remembering, advance provision, a second image of aiming, and beneficial life; I infer that the later aim judges the earlier monumental aim. A live alternative is that the verbal wish concerns deeds generally and does not reactivate the semantics of العماد.

changed_reading.before: Iram's intentionally erected order demonstrates successful purpose.
changed_reading.after: It can demonstrate misdirected purpose: immense intention made durable in the wrong temporal direction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement relocates stability from towering external props to a settled self that returns, enters a community of service, and enters a sheltered garden. Support becomes relational and interior rather than self-monumentalizing.

activation_trace.role: External propping supplies the initial model of security that the closing movement revises.
Reliance on a mainstay supplies the relational possibility later reassigned to lordship and community.
The living self supplies the interior subject in whom stability now appears.
Stillness and assurance supply a non-architectural form of settledness.
Return to a prior relation supplies directed movement away from self-grounded permanence.
Nurturing, repairing, and completing supply the sustaining relation that replaces inert props.
Mutual satisfaction supplies reciprocal acceptance rather than unilateral civic dependence.
Passing into an interior supplies the movement from exposed monument to inhabited belonging.
Humble service and obedience supply the community within which the self is supported.
A garden sheltered by vegetation supplies the final dwelling as covered refuge rather than exposed height.

structural_cues: 89:27-30 contracts from cosmic judgment to a directly addressed self, then repeats the imperative of entry.
Return precedes two entries: first into a serving community and then into a sheltered garden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies external supports, inward assurance, return, sustaining lordship, mutual acceptance, communal service, and sheltered entry; I infer a transfer of stability from monument to relation. A live alternative is that the closing promise simply contrasts with Iram's fate without redefining the focus epithet.

changed_reading.before: Security is figured by visible height, physical props, and concentrated mainstays.
changed_reading.after: Iram's supports become a foil for a quieter stability located in the settled self, sustaining relation, serving community, and sheltered interior.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the surface noun most readily evokes columns, yet the focus inventory explicitly includes damming a stream and rain-compacted soil, while the context supplies a valley channel, overtopping water, and pouring. It remains anchored in عِمَادِ but should be rendered only as an exploratory hydraulic resonance, not as a claim that Iram is lexically named as a dam.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The root of عِمَادِ at word 3 includes both blocking a stream-course and wet earth compacted by rain.

activation_trace.role: Blocking a flowing channel so water gathers supplies a direct hydraulic-earthwork possibility for the focus noun.
Rain-soaked soil compacting into a clod supplies the earthen material from which such control could be imagined.
A valley as the path of floodwater supplies the channel to be managed.
Water rising beyond bounds supplies the failure mode of attempted containment.
Pouring supplies the reversal in which controlled flow becomes an imposed descending flow.

changed_reading.before: Iram possesses only vertical architectural supports.
changed_reading.after: Iram may faintly activate as possessor of earthworks that hold and direct water, with its claimed control later reversed by overflow and pouring.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because عِمَادِ is not morphologically an injury term in the verse, but two focus branches make crushed affliction and a damaged load-bearing hump part of the same root inventory. Corruption and demolition let that latent image remain coherent. Downstream prose should qualify it as a metaphor of concealed failure beneath an impressive exterior.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: عِمَادِ at word 3 activates root branches in which crushing pain and a load-bearing hump damaged by pressure leave strength compromised.

activation_trace.role: Crushing affliction supplies the felt condition of a support system overwhelmed by what it bears.
A riding-damaged hump or pressed swelling supplies a load-bearing exterior whose apparent integrity conceals injury.
Loss of soundness and balance supplies the internal deterioration of the impressive shell.
Pounding to level supplies the eventual disclosure of a support already vulnerable to crushing.

changed_reading.before: Pillars unambiguously signify health, strength, and endurance.
changed_reading.after: The same root can cast the pillars as a strong-looking load-bearing body already injured by the burden it carries.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it maps civic architecture onto anatomy, but the focus branch explicitly includes central supporting parts of bodies and affairs, while the context contributes chest, rib weakness, breath, and another mainstay image. It remains anchored but should be presented as a body-polity analogy, never as a lexical replacement of 'pillars' by organs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The branch inventory for عِمَادِ at word 3 extends a central support from structures to bodily and systemic cores.

activation_trace.role: The central supporting part supplies the bridge from architectural column to bodily or civic core.
The chest and upper breast image lets the land term participate in an anatomical map.
A weak place in the ribs or chest supplies a vulnerable point in the body-polity's frame.
The mainstay of an affair supplies a second systemic core and keeps the analogy civic as well as bodily.
Breath emerging from within supplies the living interior absent from a merely monumental shell.

changed_reading.before: Iram is an external construction composed of supports.
changed_reading.after: Iram can be carried as a body-polity whose central frame, chest, vulnerable ribs, governing core, and breath test whether its impressive exterior is alive.

strongest_changes: The architectural pillar became a social criterion: a civilization of mainstays is judged by whether it supports people deprived of guardians, food, and distributed wealth.
Iram's vertical prestige was reversed by the later sequence of repeated leveling and repeated horizontal rows.
The focus moved from isolated monuments to an engineered landscape of raising, cutting, channeling, and anchoring.
Deliberate monumental intention was redirected by belated recollection and the wish to have sent something ahead for life.
External propping was finally contrasted with inward assurance, sustaining relation, communal belonging, and sheltered entry.
summary.what_was_special: A single rooted noun generated coexisting architectural, mobile, social, purposive, hydraulic, injured, and anatomical models. The context did not merely identify Iram; it repeatedly activated support and then changed its direction, scale, beneficiary, geometry, or material.
remaining_uncertainties: The referent carried by إرم and the feminine continuation in 89:8 may be a place, a people, or a whole social-built formation.
The temporal-axis, hydraulic, injured-support, and body-polity readings are traceable but remain analogical and branch-distant.
The later context may deliberately revise العماد, or it may place independent examples beside it whose interactions are supplied by the reader.
The tent-dweller and monumental-city baselines remain live together; the packet does not force a choice between mobile poles and fixed columns.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Pillars as height and structural pride.** Lexical evidence: `ع م د B003` pillar or column; `ع م د B005` height and elevated structure; `س م و B001` rising high from the opening name-root. Structural cue: the phrase narrows Aad into Iram characterized by supports; later `أَوْتَاد` continues the fixation/support field. Assigned role: pillars embody visible elevation and load-bearing power. Abductive move: I infer that architecture is doing ideological work: height makes power appear durable. Reading change: Iram reads as a vertical civilization-image, not just a place label.

2. **The support that becomes a weakness.** Lexical evidence: `ع م د B002` propping with a support; `ع م د B006` reliable mainstay; `ع م د B008` crushing affliction; later `د ك ك B001` crushing/demolishing until leveled. Structural cue: what is propped high early is crushed flat in 89:21. Assigned role: the pillars are both the mainstay and the point at which collapse can be imagined. Abductive move: I infer a reversal from support to affliction: the packet supplies both support and crushing branches. Reading change: the ayah foreshadows vulnerability within grandeur.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 89:21’s repeated `دَكًّا دَكًّا` retroactively changed the pillars into pre-crushed verticals; the later leveling made the earlier height feel structurally doomed.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Pillars as institutional mainstays.** **Evidence/cue:** `ع م د B003` supplies concrete columns, while `ع م د B006/B007` supplies a relied-on mainstay and an affair's central supporting part. The next ayat connect unmatched formation, rock cutting, stakes, bounded lands, and multiplied corruption. **Mechanism:** pillars carry both physical load and the social order built around monumental capacity. The packet supplies the material-social sequence; I infer that built support enables durable concentration of power. **Reading change:** Iram is characterized by a support system, not merely decorated with tall columns.

2. **Exploratory: hydraulic control latent in the supports.** **Evidence/cue:** `ع م د B013` is blocking a stream so water gathers; 89:9 places cut rock in a valley (`و د ي B005`), and 89:11 activates overflow beyond measure through `ط غ ي B002`. **Mechanism:** the branch assigns the *ʿimad* a damming role within a carved valley system. The packet supplies supports, channel, and overflow; the claim that they form one hydraulic apparatus is abductive. **Reading change:** “possessor of the supports” can evoke control of gathered flow, making later excess a reversal of controlled water into uncontrollable social force.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 89:9 and 89:11 activated the unexpected hydraulic possibility: valley-channel plus overflow gave `ع م د B013` a coherent damming role. 89:12 then corrected the neutral “support” image by showing that what sustains a system can also sustain multiplied imbalance.

concept_map.definition: Verilen söz öbeklerinde bir şeyin ayakta kalmasını sağlayan ana unsurunu, orta ya da uzunlamasına bölümünü veya direğe benzetilen belirgin parçasını anlatır. Tam karşılık, iş, organ, silah, tan ışığı ya da hayvan bacağı bağlamına göre değişir.

facets.statement: Söz öbeği, ilgili bütünün ana taşıyıcı, orta veya uzunlamasına uzanan bölümünü seçer.
İş ve görüş bağlamında, bütünün düzgün yürümesini sağlayan temel dayanağı belirtir.
Kulak, mızrak ucu, karın, sırt, karaciğer, ana damar ve kılıçta orta, ana veya uzanan yapısal parçayı belirtir.
Tan ışığının ilk yayılışı ve erkek devekuşunun direğe benzetilen bacakları da bu adlandırmaya girer.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu anlatım, ana dayanak ile orta veya uzunlamasına parça düşüncesini çeşitli söz öbeklerinde birleştirir; organ, silah, tan ve hayvan örneklerinin kapsamı kendi bağlamlarıyla sınırlıdır.

Hasta kişi, destek almadan oturamayacak ölçüde güçsüz düşebilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, binme baskısıyla hörgücün içten çökmesi ile olgunlaşmadan sıkılan yaranın şişmesini iki ayrı söz öbeğinde verir. Bunların ortak noktası baskı sonucu oluşan iç zedelenmedir; tek bir genel yara türüymüş gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca verilen hayvan ve yara kalıplarını kapsar; insanın hastalıkla güçten düşmesi bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, hörgüç ve yara kullanımlarını kendi söz öbeklerine bağlar; ortak zedelenme çekirdeğini bağımsız bir çıplak anlama dönüştürmez.

concept_map.definition: Verilen söz öbeklerinde baskı yüzünden içten zedelenmeyi anlatır: binme yükü bir devenin hörgücünü dışı sağlam görünürken içten çökertir ya da erken sıkılan yara şişer.

facets.statement: Baskı veya sıkma, dokuda dıştan hemen anlaşılmayabilen bir zedelenme oluşturur.
Binme yükü, büyük hörgücün iç yapısını çökertip bozabilir.
Olgunlaşmadan sıkılan yara, bu müdahalenin ardından şişer.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu anlatım, binme baskısıyla içten bozulan hörgüç ile erken sıkıldıktan sonra şişen yarayı kalıba bağlı iki zedelenme olarak verir.
